title: Guided setup
description: Details, template, map rows, quick price list, public page and payments. Every step can be skipped and changed later.
forbidden: The guided setup is reserved for owners and managers.

details.intro: Check name, languages and contacts: they appear on the public page and in emails to customers.

template.intro: Pick the template closest to your establishment: it creates season, zones, catalogue and rate periods that you can change.

classic_rows.name: Classic lido with rows
classic_rows.description: Umbrellas in numbered rows, priced by row and period. The most common case.

quantity_beach.name: Equipped beach by quantity
quantity_beach.description: Equipment without fixed places: you sell a number of umbrellas and sunbeds.

lido_with_pool.name: Lido with pool
lido_with_pool.description: Rows on the beach plus a pool area with sunbeds by quantity.

empty.name: Empty
empty.description: Nothing prefilled: you configure everything by hand.

rows.intro: Chosen template: {{template}}. Set how many rows and spots per row: spots are created on the map with automatic numbering.
rows.noRows: This template does not use a map with rows: zones and quantity equipment will be created.
rows.alreadyConfigured: This establishment already has a season or a map ({{spots}} spots): you can continue or edit them in the editor.

pricelist.intro: Daily price per category (row) and period of the {{year}} season. Base rules are generated automatically; half day and longer durations are configured in Prices.
pricelist.caption: Daily prices in {{currency}}
pricelist.hint: Amounts including VAT, e.g. {{example}}. Leave the cells you do not need empty.
pricelist.noSeason: A season is needed: complete the previous step or create it in Seasons and periods.
pricelist.noZones: Zones with a price category are needed: apply a template or create them in Zones.
pricelist.noPeriods: Rate periods are needed: create them in Seasons and periods.

publicPage.intro: Turn on online bookings, choose the colours and copy the code to paste into your website.

payments.intro: How you take payments: nothing to set up at the desk; to take payment for online bookings, connect your Stripe account.
payments.manualHint: Cash, card terminal or bank transfer, recorded at the cash desk. Ready now.
payments.stripeHint: Customers pay by card on the public page; the booking is confirmed only once the payment arrives. You can do this later too.

finished.title: Setup completed
finished.text: You can fine-tune everything from the Configuration menu.

reset.title: Start from scratch
reset.description: To go through the guided setup again from an empty establishment. Owner only.
reset.keeps: The establishment profile, users, online payments, emails, devices, cash registers, printers and the activity log are kept.
reset.typeName: Type the establishment name to confirm: {{name}}

configuration.blocked: There are bookings, payments or other operational data: to start over, reset the establishment.
configuration.title: Start the configuration over?
configuration.deletes: Deletes seasons and rate periods, closures, maps and spots, zones and pools, catalog, prices, promo codes, agreements, policies and entry tickets and turns the public page off until the setup is done again.
configuration.done: Configuration deleted: you can start again from the first step.

everything.title: Reset the establishment?
everything.deletes: Deletes the whole configuration as well as bookings, season passes, customers, payments, cash sessions, tickets, fiscal documents, credits, waiting list and renewals and turns the public page off until the setup is done again. Only possible while no online payment or refund is in progress.
everything.ack: I understand that bookings, customers and payments are deleted for good.
everything.done: Establishment reset: you can start again from the first step.
